अरे भाइयो, क्रिकेट जगत से आ गई है एकदम बड़ी और चौंकाने वाली खबर! 🚨

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, स्टार क्रिकेटर विराट कोहली ने साफ कर दिया है कि साल 2027 का वर्ल्ड कप इंडियन क्रिकेट टीम के लिए उनका आखिरी वनडे मैच होने वाला है।

विराट का कहना है कि उनका मुख्य लक्ष्य इस टूर्नामेंट को जीतना है, और अब उन्होंने अपना पूरा ध्यान इसी पर लगा दिया है। 🏏✨

फैंस के लिए यह पल यकीनन काफी इमोशनल होने वाला है, क्योंकि इसके बाद उनका वनडे सफर थम जाएगा।

आपको क्या लगता है, क्या विराट कोहली 2027 में टीम को वर्ल्ड कप जिता पाएंगे? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Mookuthi Amman 2: Nayanthara’s fantasy sequel to run 2 and a half hours? Here’s what we know
ctx.summary:
Mookuthi Amman 2, starring Nayanthara, is an upcoming fantasy film scheduled for a theatrical release on November 6, 2026, coinciding with Diwali. The makers have now secured certification for the film, with its final runtime coming close to two and a half hours. 
 Mookuthi Amman 2 Runtime 
 Mookuthi Amman 2  has officially received a UA 16+ certification, with a runtime of 2 hours and 25 minutes. Interestingly, the sequel is 10 minutes longer than the first instalment. 
 Sharing the update, the team wrote, “We’re all set to blow your mind with GRANDEUR, DEVOTION & POWERFUL EMOTIONS.” 
 Here’s the post: 
 The film unfolds across two timelines, beginning with a period setting in which two powerful forces prepare for a clash that threatens to unleash chaos. In the present day, a similar conflict emerges, connecting past events to a larger divine mystery. 
 At the centre of the story is a timid officer whose life becomes entangled in an extraordinary battle. With Nayanthara potentially portraying dual roles and Regena Cassandrra playing the antagonist, the film blends mythology, fantasy, and supernatural elements, with hints of additional divine figures. 
 Apart from the lead actresses, the film features Duniya Vijay, Urvashi, Yogi Babu, Maina Nandhini, Garuda Ram, Abhinaya, Shruthy S, Singampuli, and others in key roles.
